title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Central Michigan Chippewas and Notre Dame Fighting Irish, originally scheduled for Tuesday, November 24, 2026 at 8:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):

This market will resolve to "Notre Dame Fighting Irish" if the Notre Dame Fighting Irish win the game by 21 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Central Michigan Chippewas". 

The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.

If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Thursday, November 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
